payload.reason: The re-ranking approach described in the paper operates on a fixed set of top-10 candidates from a deployed QA system, utilizing the outputs of that system to improve answer selection without retraining the model. This aligns with transductive learning principles, which focus on improving predictions for a specific set of instances based on available data.

claims.text: The re-ranking approach improves answer selection based on a fixed set of top-10 candidates from a deployed QA system, which is characteristic of transductive learning.
The method learns a similarity function using features from the user query and the top-10 results, typical of transductive learning techniques.
